scripts.generate:schema: sql-schema-generator generate -c codegen.sql.schema.yml && npm run fix:format
scripts.generate:types-from-sql: sql-code-generator generate -c codegen.sql.types.yml && npm run fix:format
scripts.provision:testdb:docker:clear: for port in $(bash provision/docker/testdb/compose.sh config --format json | jq -r '.services[].ports[]?.published'); do docker rm -f $(docker ps -a -f "publish=$port" -q) 2>/dev/null || true; done && echo 'ensured ports are available 👍'
scripts.provision:testdb:docker:prepare: cp provision/schema/sql/init/.extensions.sql provision/docker/testdb/init/extensions.sql && cp provision/schema/sql/init/.schema.sql provision/docker/testdb/init/schema.sql && cp provision/schema/sql/init/.user.cicd.sql provision/docker/testdb/init/user.cicd.sql
scripts.provision:testdb: npm run provision:testdb:docker:clear && npm run provision:testdb:docker:prepare && npm run provision:testdb:docker:up && npm run provision:testdb:docker:await && ACCESS=test npm run provision:schema:plan && ACCESS=test npm run provision:schema:apply && ACCESS=test npm run provision:schema:plan
